note: tools/armor/plate_fit.py's pieces and settings (Body 14 fit2). group: 'side' = every rigid part of a side is one plate (a shell with its trims and studs: warden.pauldrons); 'sets' = rigid parts clustered by their original weight set (tol: L1 of the dense weights), one plate a cluster (lames).
